Hi Mojtaba, Hope all is well. We have encountered a new issue that we were wondering if you had thoughts on. Here's what I'm noticing: We schedule 110 sessions (~5x/day [some days have 6 surveys if the 5th session from the day before comes after midnight] for 22 days) Participants receive 5 surveys every day. The first comes within an hour of the time they wake up and the last comes within an hour of when they go to bed. Three surveys come in at semi random times between those. Our sessions are at least an hour apart (session expire within an hour). Sometimes, after uploading the 110 sessions, we get the message that all 110 were successfully scheduled, however, some do not show up on the calendar. When sessions don't show up, it's typically on the "Day" view, and it's typically a session scheduled for 00:00 - 0:59. When sessions don't show up on the "Day" view, they typically show up on the "Week" view. However, it seems like if they don't show up on the "Day" view, then they do not trigger at all. (We have not yet been able to confirm with complete certainty that this is the case.) We've attached files and a video describing the problem in case those are helpful. Thank you,Laura Laura D'Adamo, M.S. Clinical Psychology Doctoral Candidate Department of Psychological and Brain Sciences Drexel University 3201 Chestnut Street Stratton Hall Philadelphia, PA 19104 laura.a.dadamo@drexel.edu------
